title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
reuse_note: Short factual excerpts only; consult the source terms before redistributing source material.

passages.text: In light of the progress on inflation and the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/2 percentage point to 4-3/4 to 5 percent.
The Committee will continue reducing its holdings of Treasury securities and agency debt and agency mortgage-backed securities.
The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run.

title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
reuse_note: Short factual excerpts only; consult the source terms before redistributing source material.

passages.text: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 4-1/2 to 4-3/4 percent.
Since earlier in the year, labor market conditions have generally eased, and the unemployment rate has moved up but remains low.
The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run.
